about: A practice city carries every file of the template, byte for byte, except the ones listed under replaced and template_only; it may add the files listed under added (an entry ending in / adds the whole folder), the getting-started in its own language (added_in_city_language), its data, and the activated practice files. Read by the tools test that compares the city copies.

replaced.LICENSE: the template's terms extended by the practice data's terms
replaced..github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md: the template's file for the city's lang: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/<lang>.md when it exists, else the template's own file

added_data: every data_dirs entry of 4dcitygml.json, and provenance/

template_only..github/dependabot.yml: action updates run in the template only; they reach the cities through the template sync
